statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The service was ordered for ambulatory evaluation to correlate symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes submitted were I47.1 and R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
